content: Supabase Storage multi-tenant: use private buckets with object path prefix tenant_id/... and storage.objects RLS policies on (storage.foldername(name))[1] = tenant; serve via short-lived signed URLs generated by the API; never public buckets for tenant content; image transforms available. Tenancy boundary is the organization not the user. Sources: supabase storage docs, dev.to storage deep dive, makerkit RLS best practices.
